description: This source file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to facilitate the registration of grain call filters in Orleans hosting infrastructure, including deprecations and internal wrappers for filters.

classes.name: OutgoingGrainCallFilterWrapper
classes.description: Wraps an OutgoingGrainCallFilterDelegate to implement IOutgoingGrainCallFilter.

classes.name: IncomingGrainCallFilterWrapper
classes.description: Wraps an IncomingGrainCallFilterDelegate to implement IIncomingGrainCallFilter.

methods.name: AddGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Obsolete method to add a grain call filter, now throws NotSupportedException.

methods.name: AddGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Obsolete generic method to add a filter implementation, now throws NotSupportedException.

methods.name: AddGrainCallFilter (delegate)
methods.description: Obsolete method to add a filter delegate, now throws NotSupportedException.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter (internal)
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter instance to the services collection.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation> (internal)
methods.description: Adds a singleton of TImplementation where TImplementation implements IIncomingGrainCallFilter.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter (delegate) (internal)
methods.description: Wraps a delegate into a filter and adds it as singleton.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation> (internal)
methods.description: Adds a singleton of TImplementation where TImplementation implements IOutgoingGrainCallFilter.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter (delegate) (internal)
methods.description: Wraps a delegate into a filter and adds it as singleton.
